senses.gloss: (b. h.) to be bright, shine; (of sound) to shout.

units: <cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 27:1">Pesik. R. s. 27-28</cite> <he>והם מְצַהֲלוֹת אחריהם וכ׳</he> and they (the women) neighed after them like war-horses.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 97:1">Gen. R. s. 97</cite> beg. <he>יצא ופניו מַצְהִילוֹת</he> he came forth with a shining face.
<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 20:1">Pesik. R. s. 20</cite> <he>אברהם שמַצְהִיל</he> … <he>כחמה</he> Abraham who illumined the whole world like the sun.
